name: Deru Tree of Degar'Alesh
title: Deru Tree of Degar'Alesh
summary: The dead Deru Tree on Degar'Alesh (Freebooter Isle), already killed by the Old One T'thuun when Isparians first reached the island (acpedia). In the kit, four huge grey-orange trunk and crown sections form a 66 x 70 m dead tree that rises 100-109 m (top z 183) from a jungle knoll at z 74. It stands 150 m north of the great temple, with moss-green stone rubble at its roots.

site.name: Deru Tree of Degar'Alesh
site.notes: No gazetteer entry for the tree (the nearest, Olthoi Tunnel, is 290 m south on the temple avenue); derived @teleloc on the open slope 58 m south-south-east of the dead tree trunks (ground z 60.25, nearest object an invisible camp generator 5.4 m).
